rics.description: 5-7号燃料油进口量_累计同比增速_全国
rics.meaning: China regional / sectoral statistic: 5-7号燃料油进口量_累计同比增速_全国. Detailed regional or sectoral data series — original Chinese description preserved.
rics.how_to_use: Refer to source description for specific content. Regional and city-level data in the China dataset captures provincial and urban-level economic activity, often used by analysts tracking specific localities.

rics.description: Average export price, coking bituminous coal
rics.meaning: China Imports: Average export price, coking bituminous coal. Detailed import series by product/category from China Customs.
rics.how_to_use: Customs publishes detailed monthly bilateral and product-level import data. Major Chinese imports: integrated circuits, crude oil, iron ore, soybeans, copper, machinery. Track monthly YoY changes for cycle signal.

rics.description: China (Mainland), TRADE BALANCE USD (INITIAL), Current Prices, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: China Imports: China (Mainland), TRADE BALANCE USD (INITIAL), Current Prices, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs. Detailed import series by product/category from China Customs.
rics.how_to_use: Customs publishes detailed monthly bilateral and product-level import data. Major Chinese imports: integrated circuits, crude oil, iron ore, soybeans, copper, machinery. Track monthly YoY changes for cycle signal.

rics.meaning: Monthly export volume of DVD players from China Customs (~7-10th release). China dominated global DVD-player manufacturing but volumes have collapsed as streaming displaced physical media.
rics.how_to_use: Primarily a legacy indicator; sharp secular decline since the 2010s reflects consumer-electronics product-cycle shifts. Use alongside color-TV and camera export series for full CE picture.

rics.description: Export, aluminum, Imports & Exports, Annual, China Customs
rics.meaning: Annual export value of aluminum products from China Customs. China accounts for roughly 55% of global aluminum production and is the world's largest aluminum exporter.
rics.how_to_use: Use as a full-year benchmark against monthly aCNCNZPRKM. Elevated exports often trigger anti-dumping investigations from the EU and US; tariff news is a key price driver for LME aluminum.

rics.description: Export, aluminum, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of aluminum products from China Customs (~7-10th release). China's semi-fabricated aluminum exports are closely watched for dumping-margin calculations by trade partners.
rics.how_to_use: Surges often precede anti-dumping duties from the EU and US; compare against LME aluminum spot to assess export profitability and likely future volumes.

rics.description: Export, aluminum, Volume, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export volume of aluminum from China Customs (~7-10th release). Volume data strips out price effects, showing true tonnage flows to global markets.
rics.how_to_use: Compare volume trend against aCNCNZPRKM (value) to infer unit-price movements. High volumes with flat values signal price weakness; relevant for LME aluminum positioning.

rics.description: Export, aluminum, Volume, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export volume of aluminum (secondary series) from China Customs (~7-10th release). May capture a different HS sub-category of aluminum products vs aCNCNKGUPM.
rics.how_to_use: Use alongside aCNCNKGUPM to build a complete picture of China's aluminum export flows; discrepancies between the two can reflect product-mix shifts between primary and semi-finished aluminum.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of ammonium paratungstate (APT) from China Customs (~7-10th release). China controls ~80% of global tungsten supply; APT is the primary traded intermediate for hard-metal tooling and electronics.
rics.how_to_use: China periodically restricts tungsten exports via quotas; any tightening spike immediately affects global cemented-carbide and semiconductor-tooling supply chains. Track alongside export-quota announcements.

rics.description: Export, amount of zinc lanthanum (lide powder)
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of zinc-lanthanum compounds (lide powder) from China Customs (~7-10th release). Lanthanum is a light rare-earth element used in batteries, optics, and catalysts.
rics.how_to_use: Monitor alongside China's rare-earth export quota announcements; export restrictions imposed in 2023-25 on critical minerals amplify price swings. Relevant for EV battery and clean-tech supply chains.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of anthracite (high-grade thermal/industrial coal) from China Customs (~7-10th release). China is a significant anthracite exporter, particularly to South Korea and Eastern Europe.
rics.how_to_use: Seasonal spikes ahead of Northern Hemisphere winter; volumes also sensitive to domestic power demand and government export policies. Compare to coking coal exports (aCNCNZJKM) for energy-sector context.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of apple juice from China Customs (~7-10th release). China is the world's largest apple producer and a major global supplier of apple-juice concentrate.
rics.how_to_use: Seasonal pattern peaks post-autumn harvest (Oct-Jan); monitor for concentration market dynamics globally. Competing exporter volumes from Poland and Ukraine are key benchmarks.

rics.description: Export, beauty cosmetics & skin care products
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of beauty cosmetics and skin-care products from China Customs (~7-10th release). China's beauty export sector has grown rapidly driven by domestic brands expanding into ASEAN and Africa.
rics.how_to_use: Rising series reflects China's upgrade from low-cost personal-care to branded beauty; destinations include ASEAN, Middle East, and increasingly Europe. A proxy for Chinese soft-power consumer brands.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of beef from China Customs (~7-10th release). China is primarily a beef importer, so export volumes are small and mainly consist of processed/manufactured beef products.
rics.how_to_use: Relatively minor series; use in conjunction with aCNCNBCAZM to reconcile value vs volume. Divergences may indicate product-mix shifts between fresh, frozen, and processed categories.

rics.meaning: Monthly export volume of beef from China Customs (~7-10th release). Volume series complements aCNCNDSIM value data, enabling unit-price calculations for processed beef exports.
rics.how_to_use: Compare volume vs value (aCNCNDSIM) to derive implicit export price; useful for assessing competitiveness of Chinese processed meats in ASEAN and Middle East markets.

rics.description: Export, billets & rough forgings, Current Prices, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of steel billets and rough forgings (current prices) from China Customs (~7-10th release). China is the world's largest steel producer (~1 billion tonnes/year) and a major semi-finished steel exporter.
rics.how_to_use: Surge in billet exports often precedes anti-dumping measures; key markets are ASEAN, Middle East, and South Asia. Compare with aCNCNZCMUM volume series to isolate price vs volume drivers.

rics.description: Export, billets & rough forgings, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export volume of steel billets and rough forgings from China Customs (~7-10th release). Volume data is preferred for steel-market analysis as it strips out steel-price volatility.
rics.how_to_use: High volumes at low prices trigger safeguard duties globally; monitor alongside steel futures (Shanghai Futures Exchange rebar/HR coil) and ASEAN import data for arbitrage signals.

rics.description: Export, calculator, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of calculators from China Customs (~7-10th release). China dominates global calculator manufacturing; Casio, Texas Instruments, and others source heavily from Chinese factories.
rics.how_to_use: Proxy for education and office-supply demand in emerging markets; seasonal pickup ahead of back-to-school periods. Use alongside aCNCNDKJM volume series to track unit pricing.

rics.description: Export, calculator, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export volume of calculators from China Customs (~7-10th release). Volume series for China's calculator exports, enabling per-unit price tracking alongside aCNCNZOTVM.
rics.how_to_use: Flat or declining volumes with rising values suggest premiumization toward scientific/graphing calculators; compare against aCNCNZERM (keyboards/mice) for overall office-electronics export trend.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of cameras from China Customs (~7-10th release). China manufactures cameras for global brands (Canon, Sony, Nikon) and its own labels; action cameras and security cameras are growth segments.
rics.how_to_use: Distinguish consumer (smartphone-displacing DSLR decline) from security/surveillance camera growth; the latter is robust but faces US/EU restrictions on Chinese surveillance hardware.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of canned pork from China Customs (~7-10th release). China is the world's largest pork producer and exporter of processed pork products to ASEAN and Pacific markets.
rics.how_to_use: Seasonal demand spikes around Chinese New Year and summer; global pork-price moves and African swine fever cycles affect domestic supply and thus export capacity. Track alongside live-pig exports (aCNCNNQCKM).

rics.description: Export, cashmere, Current Prices, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of cashmere products from China Customs (~7-10th release). China and Mongolia together supply ~90% of global cashmere fiber; China dominates downstream spinning and garment manufacturing.
rics.how_to_use: Premium luxury-textile indicator; demand closely tied to European and US high-end retail cycles. Compare with aCNCNPKADM volume to track per-kg export prices and premiumization trends.

rics.description: Export, cashmere, Volume, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export volume of cashmere from China Customs (~7-10th release). Volume series complements aCNCNWFNCM value data to derive implicit per-kg export price.
rics.how_to_use: Volume declines with stable values indicate pricing power and product upgrading; monitor alongside Mongolian raw-cashmere production data for supply-chain context.

rics.meaning: Quarterly export value of cassava products from China Customs. China re-exports cassava-based starch and ethanol products, primarily sourced from ASEAN neighbors for domestic processing.
rics.how_to_use: Quarterly frequency limits real-time use; relevant for Southeast Asian cassava price dynamics and China's starch/ethanol refining sector margins.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of cassava products from China Customs (~7-10th release). Monthly version of the cassava export series; China's cassava exports are primarily starch and chips to regional markets.
rics.how_to_use: ASEAN (Thailand, Vietnam) is the key origin for Chinese cassava imports that are then processed and re-exported; shifts reflect China's food-processing competitiveness.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of coke and semi-coke from China Customs (~7-10th release). China is the world's dominant coke exporter; coke is essential for blast-furnace steel production globally.
rics.how_to_use: Export volumes heavily influence global coking-coal spreads; key buyers are India, Japan, South Korea, and Brazil. Government export quotas are a recurring policy lever, especially during domestic steel demand surges.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of coking (bituminous) coal from China Customs (~7-10th release). China is a significant coking-coal exporter but volumes have declined as domestic steel demand absorbs supply.
rics.how_to_use: Monitor alongside Chinese steel production; rising steel output typically reduces coal available for export. Subject to export quotas and tariff adjustments.

rics.description: Export, color television sets (including complete sets of spare parts)
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of color television sets (including CKD kits) from China Customs (~7-10th release). China dominates global TV manufacturing with brands TCL, Hisense, Skyworth exporting globally.
rics.how_to_use: Seasonal peaks ahead of Western holiday shopping (Q4); ASEAN and Africa are growth destinations as Chinese brands displace Japanese/Korean rivals on price. Monitor for EU anti-dumping risk.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of compound fertilizers from China Customs (~7-10th release). China is the world's largest fertilizer producer and exporter of NPK compounds, urea, and DAP.
rics.how_to_use: Government export quotas restrict outflows during domestic planting seasons (spring/autumn); releases coincide with global fertilizer price surges. Key for global food security and EM agricultural margins.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of copper and copper products from China Customs (~7-10th release). China is both the world's largest copper consumer and a significant refined-copper and copper-product exporter.
rics.how_to_use: Rising copper exports indicate domestic demand weakness or inventory build; acts as a leading indicator for Chinese construction/manufacturing demand. Compare with LME-SHFE copper arbitrage to explain flow direction.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of corn from China Customs (~7-10th release). China alternates between net corn importer and exporter depending on domestic harvest; any export surge significantly moves global corn markets.
rics.how_to_use: Large corn-export announcements (especially to ASEAN and North Africa) pressure CBOT corn futures; monitor alongside domestic corn prices (DCE futures) for export economics.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of cotton yarn from China Customs (~7-10th release). China is the world's largest cotton spinner; cotton-yarn exports primarily go to ASEAN garment manufacturers (Bangladesh, Vietnam, Cambodia).
rics.how_to_use: Reflects competitiveness of Chinese spinning vs regional rivals; rising values can compress downstream ASEAN garment-maker margins. Monitor alongside Chinese cotton import data for full textile supply-chain picture.

rics.description: Export, crude oil, Current Prices, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of crude oil from China Customs (~7-10th release). China is primarily a large crude importer (~11 mb/d), so crude oil exports are minor re-exports or condensate streams.
rics.how_to_use: Small and volatile series; compare against crude import data (aCNCNIPQCM volume) to assess refinery throughput and any arbitrage-driven re-export activity. Limited global market impact.

rics.description: Export, crude oil, Volume, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export volume of crude oil from China Customs (~7-10th release). Volume series for China's crude-oil exports, enabling per-barrel price comparison against aCNCNSAWNM value.
rics.how_to_use: Primarily tracks small re-export or processing-trade crude flows; combine with China's crude import volume data for a net-balance view of Chinese oil trade.

rics.description: Export, crude oil, Volume, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export volume of crude oil (secondary series) from China Customs (~7-10th release). Likely captures a different classification category of crude or condensate exports vs aCNCNIPQCM.
rics.how_to_use: Use alongside aCNCNIPQCM to build a complete crude-export volume picture; differences may reflect condensate vs full-range crude categorizations under China Customs HS codes.

rics.meaning: Monthly aggregate current-price export value from China Customs (~7-10th release). Headline current-price total merchandise export series, the most widely cited export indicator for China.
rics.how_to_use: Consensus forecasts generate significant market moves on release; ~$300B/month recently. Surprise vs consensus shifts USD/CNY, EM equities, and commodity futures. Top destinations: ASEAN, US, EU.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of dairy products from China Customs (~7-10th release). China is primarily a dairy importer; small dairy exports are mainly infant formula and UHT milk to ASEAN and developing markets.
rics.how_to_use: Niche series; rising exports may indicate excess domestic supply or competitiveness gains in processed dairy. Monitor alongside Chinese milk production data for domestic oversupply signals.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of diesel fuel from China Customs (~7-10th release). China periodically exports surplus diesel when refinery runs exceed domestic demand; key buyers are ASEAN and Africa.
rics.how_to_use: Export quotas (permits) are issued by NDRC; quota tightening reduces global diesel supply and lifts Asian refinery crack spreads. Correlates with Sinopec/PetroChina refinery run rates.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of displays (panels) from China Customs (~7-10th release). China's BOE, CSOT, and HKC have surpassed Korean and Taiwanese rivals in LCD panel production for TVs and monitors.
rics.how_to_use: Panel export value tracks global TV and monitor demand cycles; seasonal Q3 build-ahead-of-holiday peak is typical. Relevant for BOE and downstream global TV brand margins.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of dried pepper from China Customs (~7-10th release). China is a major producer of chili peppers and dried spices; key export destinations include ASEAN, Middle East, and South Asia.
rics.how_to_use: Seasonal harvest patterns (autumn peak); monitor alongside Indian spice exports for global pepper price competition. Relatively small series but useful for agricultural commodity tracking.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of engined car chassis from China Customs (~7-10th release). China's auto chassis exports support CKD assembly operations in Africa, ASEAN, and Latin America for both ICE and EV platforms.
rics.how_to_use: Rising chassis exports indicate expansion of Chinese OEM overseas assembly strategies (SAIC, Great Wall, Chery); correlates with tariff-evasion strategies in response to EU/US vehicle import duties.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of fluorite (fluorspar) from China Customs (~7-10th release). China holds ~60% of global fluorite reserves and dominates exports of this key input for hydrofluoric acid, refrigerants, and aluminum smelting.
rics.how_to_use: Subject to export quotas; restrictions tighten hydrofluoric acid and refrigerant supply globally. Watch for Chinese quota reduction announcements, which immediately impact specialty chemical and semiconductor fab costs.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of fresh and frozen shrimp from China Customs (~7-10th release). China is a top global shrimp producer and exporter; key markets are Japan, US, and EU.
rics.how_to_use: Seasonal demand peaks ahead of holidays; aquaculture disease outbreaks (white spot, EMS) affect supply. Compare with aCNCNOHHMM (frozen shrimp only) to decompose product-form mix.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of frozen chicken from China Customs (~7-10th release). China is a major frozen-chicken exporter mainly to Japan, Hong Kong, and ASEAN; avian influenza outbreaks periodically disrupt flows.
rics.how_to_use: Bird-flu surveillance data is the key risk variable; bilateral import bans after AI outbreaks cause sharp export drops. Seasonal processing peaks in Q3-Q4 align with Northern Hemisphere autumn demand.

rics.description: Export, frozen fish & frozen fish fillets
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of frozen fish and frozen fish fillets from China Customs (~7-10th release). China is the world's largest fish processor; it imports raw fish (Alaska pollock, Pacific cod) and re-exports processed fillets.
rics.how_to_use: Track alongside US/Russian pollock harvest data, as China re-exports processed fillets to EU and US; tariff escalation (Section 301 tariffs on seafood) disrupts these flows.

rics.description: Export, frozen fish & frozen fish fillets
rics.meaning: Monthly export volume of frozen fish and frozen fish fillets from China Customs (~7-10th release). Volume series for China's frozen-fish exports; pairs with aCNCNMPTM value to derive per-kg export price.
rics.how_to_use: Rising volumes with flat values signal oversupply or price pressure; relevant for global seafood processing margins and Alaska pollock/Pacific cod commodity pricing.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of frozen shrimp from China Customs (~7-10th release). Distinct from aCNCNROSBM which includes fresh shrimp; frozen shrimp is the dominant traded form for retail and food-service.
rics.how_to_use: Key indicator for global farmed-shrimp markets; compare with Ecuador and India shrimp export data for competitive positioning. Buyer destinations: Japan, US, EU food processors.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of gaseous (compressed/liquefied) gas from China Customs (~7-10th release). Covers compressed natural gas (CNG) and possibly LPG exports from China's growing gas infrastructure.
rics.how_to_use: Small but growing series as China builds gas export infrastructure; relevant for regional (ASEAN, Central Asia) natural gas market development and pipeline-vs-LNG competition.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of glass products from China Customs (~7-10th release). China dominates global flat-glass and specialty-glass production; solar-panel glass is a high-growth export as China holds 80%+ of global solar PV manufacturing.
rics.how_to_use: Solar glass exports face anti-dumping duties in EU and India; monitor trade-remedy filings. Solar panel installation pipeline globally drives demand for Chinese solar glass. Also relevant for construction-demand indicators.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of handheld radiotelephones (mobile phones) and parts from China Customs (~7-10th release). China manufactures ~70% of the world's smartphones; Apple (iPhone), Samsung, and Chinese OEMs (Xiaomi, OPPO, vivo) all ship from China.
rics.how_to_use: One of China's largest single export categories (~$150B+/year); sensitive to US tariff escalation (Section 301) and supply-chain relocation to India/Vietnam. iPhone launch cycles create Q3-Q4 seasonal peaks.

rics.description: Export, ketchup, Current Prices, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of ketchup (tomato paste/sauce) from China Customs (~7-10th release). China is the world's second-largest tomato processor; Xinjiang tomatoes dominate Chinese tomato-paste exports to Africa and ASEAN.
rics.how_to_use: Seasonal processing peak following summer harvest; African and Middle Eastern buyers dominate. Compare with aCNCNZGAM for volume to track pricing trends in bulk tomato paste.

rics.description: Export, ketchup, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of ketchup (tomato products) from China Customs (~7-10th release). Likely represents a different HS sub-category or aggregation level of tomato products vs aCNCNAFMZM.
rics.how_to_use: Use alongside aCNCNAFMZM and aCNCNFRADM to build a complete picture of China's tomato-product exports; discrepancies indicate product-mix shifts between paste, sauce, and whole tomatoes.

rics.description: Export, ketchup, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export volume of ketchup/tomato products from China Customs (~7-10th release). Volume series for China's tomato-product exports; use with aCNCNAFMZM value data to derive per-tonne pricing.
rics.how_to_use: Xinjiang harvest-year quality and yield are key supply drivers; African state buyers' purchasing patterns create lumpy demand. Volume peaks in Q1-Q2 following autumn harvest processing.

rics.meaning: Monthly export volume of keyboards and mice from China Customs (~7-10th release). China manufactures the vast majority of global PC peripherals; Logitech, Razer, and most white-label brands source from Chinese factories.
rics.how_to_use: Tracks global PC and gaming peripheral demand cycle; WFH demand surge (2020-21) and subsequent normalization are visible in this series. Compare against aCNCNDKJM and aCNCNCGZLM for electronics cycle picture.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of leather gloves from China Customs (~7-10th release). China dominates global glove manufacturing for work, fashion, and sport segments; key buyers are EU and North America.
rics.how_to_use: Labor-cost sensitivity makes this a canary for Chinese apparel-export competitiveness vs Bangladesh and Vietnam. Seasonal demand peaks pre-winter (Q3-Q4 Northern Hemisphere orders).

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of lignite (brown coal) from China Customs (~7-10th release). China's lignite exports are small as most lignite is consumed near mine-mouth for power generation; exports are mainly to regional buyers.
rics.how_to_use: Minor coal-export series; use alongside anthracite (aCNCNUTOSM) and coking coal (aCNCNZJKM) for a complete view of China's coal-export basket by grade.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of live pigs (non-breeding) from China Customs (~7-10th release). China's live-pig exports go primarily to Hong Kong and Macao; volumes are sensitive to African swine fever (ASF) outbreaks.
rics.how_to_use: ASF epidemic cycles (2018-19 decimated Chinese herd; partial recovery by 2022) drive sharp swings; Hong Kong pork prices closely track these flows. Use alongside canned pork (aCNCNJEJGM) for complete pork export picture.

rics.description: Export, magnesium & its products (including waste & scrap)
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of magnesium and magnesium products (including scrap) from China Customs (~7-10th release). China produces ~85% of the world's primary magnesium, primarily in Shaanxi and Shanxi provinces.
rics.how_to_use: 2021 Chinese energy crisis caused magnesium output collapse, spiking global prices and threatening European aluminum-alloy and automotive supply chains. Monitor Chinese power-shortage signals as a leading indicator.

rics.description: Export, magnesium & its products (including waste & scrap)
rics.meaning: Monthly export volume of magnesium and magnesium products from China Customs (~7-10th release). Volume series for China's magnesium exports; pairs with aCNCNPKLIM value to derive per-tonne export price.
rics.how_to_use: Volume contraction (as in H2 2021) with price spikes signals genuine supply squeeze vs price-driven demand destruction; critical for European auto-parts and aerospace supply-chain risk models.

rics.description: Export, manufactured or preserved squid, Current Prices, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of manufactured/preserved squid (current prices) from China Customs (~7-10th release). China processes squid from domestic fisheries and imported raw squid into preserved/canned/frozen products for export.
rics.how_to_use: South American Humboldt squid supply (Peru/Argentina IUU fishing indicators) affects Chinese raw-squid import costs and thus export competitiveness. Japan and South Korea are key markets.

rics.description: Export, manufactured or preserved squid, Current Prices, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of manufactured/preserved squid (current prices, secondary series) from China Customs (~7-10th release). Likely captures a different HS sub-category or product form of preserved squid vs aCNCNFNXDM.
rics.how_to_use: Use alongside aCNCNFNXDM to reconcile total squid-export value; discrepancies illuminate product-mix shifts between dried, canned, and frozen-prepared squid categories.

rics.description: Export, manufactured or preserved squid, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of manufactured/preserved squid from China Customs (~7-10th release). One of multiple series tracking China's squid-product exports under different HS code aggregations.
rics.how_to_use: Aggregate with related squid series (aCNCNFNXDM, aCNCNHYCKM, aCNCNBMXLM) to build total squid export picture; useful for global cephalopod market analysis.

rics.description: Export, manufactured or preserved squid, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export volume of manufactured/preserved squid from China Customs (~7-10th release). Volume series for China's preserved-squid exports; use with value series to compute per-kg export price.
rics.how_to_use: Volume vs value divergence indicates changing product mix or pricing power; Japanese and South Korean retail demand cycles create seasonal patterns. Compare with global squid catch data for supply signals.

rics.description: Export, manufactured or preserved squid, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of manufactured/preserved squid (additional series) from China Customs (~7-10th release). Captures a further HS sub-category of processed squid products in China's export classification.
rics.how_to_use: Use in aggregate with other squid series for total market size; individually tracks specific product-form exports (e.g., squid rings, tubes) for foodservice vs retail destination analysis.

rics.description: Export, manufactured or preserved squid, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export volume of manufactured/preserved squid (additional volume series) from China Customs (~7-10th release). Final squid volume series in the batch; captures residual HS sub-categories of squid products.
rics.how_to_use: Aggregate all six squid series (aCNCNFNXDM through aCNCNIZKEM) for China's total processed-squid export footprint; useful for global squid commodity pricing and fishing-quota impact analysis.

rics.description: Export, manufactured or preserved squid, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of manufactured or preserved squid, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Reflects downstream processing capacity and demand from key buyers in Japan, South Korea, and the EU.
rics.how_to_use: Track alongside broader seafood export trends; seasonal peaks around Chinese New Year and summer. Weakness can signal soft consumer demand abroad or tighter sanitary inspections.

rics.description: Export, manufactured or preserved squid, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of manufactured or preserved squid, alternate valuation series from China Customs. Provides a cross-check on aCNCNEBQYM for reconciling reporting discrepancies.
rics.how_to_use: Compare with the companion volume series (aCNCNIAEMM) to derive implied unit prices and detect shifts in product mix or destination markets.

rics.description: Export, manufactured or preserved squid, Volume, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export volume of manufactured or preserved squid, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Volume data captures quantity shipped independent of price swings.
rics.how_to_use: Pair with the value series (aCNCNEBQYM) to compute unit export prices; divergence between value and volume growth signals price changes in destination markets.

rics.description: Export, manufactured or preserved squid, Volume, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export volume of manufactured or preserved squid, alternate volume series from China Customs. Useful for verifying aCNCNIAEMM and detecting data revisions.
rics.how_to_use: Use alongside the value counterpart to assess whether volume or pricing is driving revenue changes in China's squid export trade.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of memory chips, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Reflects China's re-export and assembly role in the global semiconductor supply chain.
rics.how_to_use: Watch for correlation with global DRAM/NAND price cycles; a surge in export value without volume growth implies price recovery. Sensitive to US export controls on advanced chips.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of metal processing machine tools, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Reflects China's growing competitiveness in industrial capital goods exports.
rics.how_to_use: Rising machine tool exports signal China moving up the manufacturing value chain; compare with imports of high-end German/Japanese machine tools to gauge technology gap closure.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of molybdenum ore and concentrates, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. China is among the top global molybdenum producers; exports serve steel alloying demand in Europe and Asia.
rics.how_to_use: Track alongside global steel output data; molybdenum demand is tied to high-strength steel for infrastructure and energy sectors. Export quotas or environmental inspections can cause sharp supply squeezes.

rics.meaning: Monthly export volume of molybdenum ore and concentrates, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Volume series complements the value data for deriving implied prices.
rics.how_to_use: Compare value and volume to extract unit prices; policy-driven export restrictions common in critical minerals — volume drops ahead of formal quota announcements can be an early signal.

rics.description: Export, naphtha, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of naphtha, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Reflects surplus refinery output as China's mega-refineries run above domestic demand.
rics.how_to_use: Naphtha exports rise when domestic petrochemical demand is weak or refinery runs are high; track alongside crude oil import volumes and domestic PMI to assess refinery utilization cycles.

rics.description: Export, naphtha, Volume, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export volume of naphtha, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Volume data isolates physical flows from price effects.
rics.how_to_use: Large volume spikes suggest domestic refinery oversupply; compare against Singapore naphtha crack spreads to understand export economics and destination arbitrage.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of natural barium sulfate (barite), released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. China dominates global barite supply, used in oil drilling mud and paints.
rics.how_to_use: Monitor alongside global oil drilling activity; demand for barite spikes when offshore and onshore rig counts rise. Export controls on critical minerals can abruptly restrict supply.

rics.description: Export, natural graphite, Current Prices, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of natural graphite, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. China controls ~65% of global natural graphite supply, a critical input for EV battery anodes.
rics.how_to_use: Highly strategic series — China imposed graphite export controls in late 2023 targeting the EV supply chain. Monitor for policy-driven disruptions affecting global battery makers.

rics.description: Export, natural graphite, Volume, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export volume of natural graphite, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Volume series is critical given China's export licensing regime introduced in 2023.
rics.how_to_use: Volume declines post-export-control implementation reveal the real supply impact on global EV battery producers; pair with value data to see price discovery in a controlled market.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of natural honey, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. China is the world's largest honey producer and exporter, supplying primarily the EU, US, and Japan.
rics.how_to_use: Watch for anti-dumping investigations and food safety incidents — the EU and US have imposed duties on Chinese honey over adulteration concerns, causing sharp export volume swings.

rics.description: Export, natural magnesium carbonate, magnesium oxide, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of natural magnesium carbonate and magnesium oxide, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. China is the dominant global supplier of magnesia, used in refractory materials and steel production.
rics.how_to_use: Steel sector demand drives magnesia exports; weakness in global steel output cascades to lower magnesia export volumes. Track alongside China steel export data for corroboration.

rics.description: Export, natural magnesium carbonate, magnesium oxide, Volume, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export volume of natural magnesium carbonate and magnesium oxide, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Volume series isolates physical tonnage shipped.
rics.how_to_use: Compare with value series (aCNCNXIKJM) to derive unit prices; China's dominance in magnesia creates pricing power — watch for energy cost pass-through in export prices.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of newsprint, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Newsprint exports reflect China's paper production capacity and declining domestic print media demand.
rics.how_to_use: Secular decline expected as digital media displaces print; short-term swings driven by global paper supply-demand dynamics and pulp input costs. Niche series with limited macro signaling.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of other fuel oil, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Captures residual fuel oil flows from China's large independent teapot refineries targeting bunker fuel and power generation markets.
rics.how_to_use: Track alongside China's overall oil product export quotas; the government periodically tightens quotas to manage domestic fuel supply, causing sharp export volume and price swings.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of paraffin wax, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Paraffin is a refinery by-product exported to candle, cosmetics, and packaging markets globally.
rics.how_to_use: Watch refinery run rates and crude oil composition for supply-side signals; paraffin export volumes tend to co-move with broader petroleum product export cycles.

rics.meaning: Monthly export volume of paraffin wax, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Volume series for the paraffin trade, complementing the value series.
rics.how_to_use: Pair with aCNCNNPYM to compute implied unit export prices; paraffin is a commodity by-product so prices closely track global crude differentials and refinery economics.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of peanut oil, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. China is a major peanut producer; peanut oil exports target Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Africa.
rics.how_to_use: Track alongside domestic peanut harvest forecasts and global edible oil prices (palm, soy); competitive dynamics with Southeast Asian palm oil often dictate China's peanut oil export volumes.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of pharmaceutical products, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. China is the world's leading API (active pharmaceutical ingredient) exporter, supplying global generic drug manufacturers.
rics.how_to_use: Monitor for supply-chain diversification trends — the COVID-19 pandemic triggered global efforts to reduce API dependence on China. Rising exports reflect demand recovery; watch for anti-dumping actions in the EU and US.

rics.description: Export, pig iron & mirror iron, Current Prices, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of pig iron and mirror iron, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Pig iron exports reflect excess blast furnace output amid China's domestic property-sector weakness since 2022.
rics.how_to_use: Elevated pig iron exports signal domestic steel demand weakness and mill overcapacity. Rising exports often trigger anti-dumping probes by the EU, India, and Southeast Asian nations.

rics.description: Export, pig iron & mirror iron, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export volume of pig iron and mirror iron, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Volume data is the key metric for tracking overcapacity-driven export surges.
rics.how_to_use: Volume spikes confirm overcapacity displacement; compare with domestic Chinese steel PMI and property starts data. Sustained high volumes increase the probability of coordinated international anti-dumping tariffs.

rics.description: Export, plastic woven bags except turnover bags
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of plastic woven bags (excluding turnover bags), released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. China dominates global woven bag production for agricultural, construction, and retail packaging.
rics.how_to_use: Track alongside broader plastics and chemical export trends; demand from ASEAN, Africa, and Latin America is the primary driver. Rising global commodity trade volumes increase woven bag demand.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of pork, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. China is both the world's largest pork consumer and a significant exporter of processed and canned pork products.
rics.how_to_use: Monitor the domestic hog cycle — ASF (African swine fever) outbreaks reduce domestic supply and exports. Export volumes tend to be countercyclical to domestic pork prices.

rics.description: Export, potassium chloride, Current Prices, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of potassium chloride (MOP — muriate of potash), released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. China is both a major importer and processor/re-exporter of potash fertilizers.
rics.how_to_use: China's potash trade is strategically sensitive — government periodically restricts fertilizer exports to protect domestic agriculture. Watch export surges as a signal of domestic supply abundance.

rics.description: Export, potassium chloride, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export volume of potassium chloride, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Volume series for potash exports, critical for global agricultural supply chains.
rics.how_to_use: Volume data is more policy-sensitive than value; government export bans or quotas show up immediately in volume collapses. Pair with global potash price data to assess China's market impact.

rics.description: Export, potassium sulfate, Current Prices, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of potassium sulfate (SOP — sulfate of potash), released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. SOP is a premium fertilizer used on chloride-sensitive crops; China is a leading producer.
rics.how_to_use: SOP exports target high-value agricultural markets (fruits, vegetables). Track alongside global SOP prices and domestic production data; Chinese export policy shapes global SOP supply and pricing.

rics.description: Export, potassium sulfate, Volume, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export volume of potassium sulfate, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Volume series for SOP, the premium potash fertilizer segment.
rics.how_to_use: Compare value and volume series to extract unit export prices; China's Mannheim process SOP production is cost-competitive globally — rising volumes can pressure international prices.

rics.description: Export, potato & starch-containing tuber, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of potatoes and starch-containing tubers, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. China exports processed potato products and fresh tubers primarily to Southeast Asia.
rics.how_to_use: Track alongside domestic harvest conditions and ASEAN food demand; food safety incidents or phytosanitary restrictions can abruptly disrupt export flows.

rics.description: Export, potato & starch-containing tuber, Volume, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export volume of potatoes and starch-containing tubers, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Volume series captures physical shipments.
rics.how_to_use: Compare value and volume to derive implied unit prices; seasonal harvest cycles drive predictable volume patterns. Useful for cross-checking aCNCNVLCM for data consistency.

rics.description: Export, potato & tuber containing starch, Current Prices, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of potatoes and starch-containing tubers at current prices, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Alternative value series for this category.
rics.how_to_use: Use alongside aCNCNVLCM and aCNCNEHNUM to reconcile potential reporting differences across Customs databases; annual series aCNCNUMJF provides full-year benchmark.

rics.description: Export, potato & tuber containing starch, Current Prices, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of potatoes and starch-containing tubers at current prices, second monthly series from China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Parallel value track for cross-validation.
rics.how_to_use: Cross-check against aCNCNRAZM and aCNCNVLCM; persistent divergences may reflect different HS code classifications or data source revisions.

rics.description: Export, potato & tuber containing starch, Imports & Exports, Annual, China Customs
rics.meaning: Annual export value of potatoes and starch-containing tubers, released by China Customs on an annual basis. Provides the full-year benchmark for reconciling monthly cumulative figures.
rics.how_to_use: Use to validate monthly series cumulative totals; annual data is less subject to seasonal adjustment noise and provides a clean trend-level view of China's tuber export position.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of PVC in primary shapes, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. China is one of the world's largest PVC producers; domestic overcapacity drives exports to ASEAN, South Asia, and Africa.
rics.how_to_use: PVC exports rise when domestic demand is weak (property sector slowdown) and when global construction activity is robust. Anti-dumping duties from India and Southeast Asian countries are a recurring theme.

rics.description: Export, pure electric car & off-road vehicle, Current Prices, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of pure electric cars and off-road vehicles, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. China overtook Japan as the world's largest auto exporter in 2023, led by NEV brands (BYD, SAIC, Chery).
rics.how_to_use: One of the highest-profile China export series; surge post-2022 reflects EV competitiveness. Watch for EU anti-subsidy tariffs (imposed 2024), US 100% tariffs, and destination market diversification to ASEAN and Middle East.

rics.description: Export, pure electric car & off-road vehicle, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export volume (units) of pure electric cars and off-road vehicles, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Unit count is the most direct measure of China's EV export penetration.
rics.how_to_use: Volume in units is more transparent than value for tracking market share gains; compare with aCNCNZTWM to derive average selling prices. Volume growth in Europe and Southeast Asia is politically sensitive.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of radio equipment including recording devices, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Captures a broad category of consumer and professional audio/radio electronics.
rics.how_to_use: Useful as a proxy for mid-range consumer electronics export trends; supplements smartphone and laptop export data. Sensitive to US tariffs on Chinese electronics and supply chain shifts to Vietnam.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of rapeseed oil and mustard oil, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. China exports surplus edible oils to regional markets, though canola imports from Canada dominate domestic supply.
rics.how_to_use: Track alongside global canola/rapeseed prices and China's domestic crush margins; export volumes are often small relative to imports, so this series is a niche vegetable oil trade indicator.

rics.description: Export, raw silk, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of raw silk, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. China controls roughly 70-80% of global raw silk production; key destinations include India, Italy, and Japan.
rics.how_to_use: Raw silk exports are a niche but strategically important luxury input; track seasonal sericulture cycles. Italian and French luxury fashion demand is the primary Western pull factor.

rics.description: Export, raw silk, Volume, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export volume of raw silk, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Volume series for China's dominant raw silk export position.
rics.how_to_use: Pair with aCNCNWJPMM to track unit prices; raw silk prices are highly volatile. Volume declines can signal domestic silk weaving industry expansion absorbing more output before export.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of roasted peanuts, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. China is a leading peanut processor and exporter; roasted peanuts target snack food markets in Europe, Middle East, and Southeast Asia.
rics.how_to_use: Track alongside global peanut prices and domestic harvest data; food safety recalls (aflatoxin incidents) have historically caused sharp disruptions to Chinese peanut exports in the EU.

rics.meaning: Monthly export volume of steel scrap, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. China's scrap export market is small relative to imports, but volume surges signal shifts in domestic EAF steelmaking economics.
rics.how_to_use: Watch for policy changes on scrap exports (restricted in many years); rising scrap exports suggest domestic recycled steel supply exceeds mill absorption capacity.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of steel scrap, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Value series for China's scrap metal trade.
rics.how_to_use: Pair with volume series (aCNCNGLLEM) for unit price computation; scrap prices track global steel market conditions closely. China's scrap export policy is frequently adjusted for strategic reasons.

rics.description: Export, small passenger car (including complete sets of spare parts)
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of small passenger cars including complete sets of spare parts (CKD), released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Covers both ICE and EV passenger vehicles in this size class.
rics.how_to_use: Broadest passenger car export indicator; compare with EV-specific series (aCNCNZTWM) to gauge ICE vs. EV mix. Growing CKD shipments signal OEM local assembly partnerships in emerging markets.

rics.description: Export, soda ash, Current Prices, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of soda ash (sodium carbonate), released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. China is the world's largest soda ash producer; exports serve glass, detergent, and chemical industries globally.
rics.how_to_use: Soda ash exports surge when domestic property glass demand is depressed; monitor alongside China housing starts. Anti-dumping investigations from Turkey, India, and the EU are recurring risks.

rics.description: Export, soda ash, Current Prices, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of soda ash at current prices, alternate series from China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Provides a secondary data source for cross-validation.
rics.how_to_use: Use alongside aCNCNSSVHM to verify reported values; persistent divergences between the two series may indicate classification or reporting differences. Compare with volume series aCNCNLARM.

rics.description: Export, soda ash, Volume, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export volume of soda ash, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Volume is the key metric for tracking China's soda ash export displacement in global markets.
rics.how_to_use: Volume spikes amid weak domestic construction demand confirm overcapacity export displacement; compare with aCNCNSSVHM to compute realized export unit prices vs. global soda ash benchmark prices.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of sorghum, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. China exports limited volumes of sorghum; the series primarily reflects niche trade flows to neighboring countries.
rics.how_to_use: Sorghum exports are small relative to China's massive imports; track primarily to monitor domestic supply conditions. Any significant export surge would imply an unusual domestic surplus.

rics.meaning: Monthly export value of soybeans, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. China is a massive net importer of soybeans; exports are negligible and represent minor re-export or specialty flows.
rics.how_to_use: This series should be monitored mainly for anomalies; a sudden surge in soybean exports would be highly unusual and could signal domestic storage or policy changes. The import counterpart is far more strategically important.

rics.meaning: Monthly export volume of soybeans, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Volume series for the minor soybean re-export or specialty trade flows.
rics.how_to_use: Low-volume series given China's net importer status; pair with aCNCNKRWDM for unit price verification. Any sustained volume increase would warrant investigation into supply chain shifts or policy changes.

rics.description: Export, soybean oil, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of soybean oil, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. China's large crush industry produces surplus soybean oil beyond domestic demand, exported to ASEAN and Africa.
rics.how_to_use: Track alongside domestic soybean crush margins and global edible oil prices; surplus crushing capacity drives soybean oil export volumes. Competition with Malaysian palm oil is the key dynamic.

rics.description: Export, soybean oil, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of soybean oil, alternate value series from China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Second monthly data track for cross-validation.
rics.how_to_use: Use with aCNCNPQSDM and aCNCNMGBBM to reconcile any inter-series discrepancies; the volume series aCNCNJHQOM and aCNCNTZZNM provide the physical quantity counterpart.

rics.description: Export, soybean oil, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of soybean oil, third value series from China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Parallel reporting track for soybean oil export values.
rics.how_to_use: With three parallel value series (aCNCNPQSDM, aCNCNPLHPM, aCNCNMGBBM), triangulate for the most reliable value read; compare against volume series to derive unit pricing trends.

rics.description: Export, soybean oil, Volume, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export volume of soybean oil, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Volume series captures physical shipments of China's surplus crush output.
rics.how_to_use: Pair with value series (aCNCNPQSDM) to compute realized export unit prices and compare with Rotterdam soybean oil benchmarks. Rising volumes indicate domestic crush surplus relative to consumption.

rics.description: Export, soybean oil, Volume, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export volume of soybean oil, alternate volume series from China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Second volume data track for cross-validation.
rics.how_to_use: Cross-check against aCNCNJHQOM; divergence between the two volume series may signal HS classification differences or reporting lags. Use the average of both for a best-estimate volume read.

rics.description: Export, sulfur, Current Prices, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of elemental sulfur, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Sulfur is a by-product of oil refining and coal coking; China is a large producer with exports targeting fertilizer manufacturers (sulfuric acid).
rics.how_to_use: Sulfur exports reflect refinery and coking activity levels; track alongside China's crude run rates. Global fertilizer demand — particularly phosphate production — is the primary end-user pull.

rics.description: Export, sulfur, Current Prices, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of elemental sulfur, alternate value series from China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Provides a secondary data track for cross-validation.

rics.description: Export, sulfur, Volume, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export volume of elemental sulfur, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Volume series captures physical sulfur flows from Chinese refineries and coking plants to global markets.
rics.how_to_use: Volume is the key driver variable; pair with aCNCNWHHM for unit price calculation. Sulfur export volumes are highly seasonal and correlated with refinery maintenance schedules.

rics.description: Export, textile garment, Current Prices, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly export value of textile garments at current prices, released by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. China remains the world's largest garment exporter despite manufacturing share shifting to Vietnam, Bangladesh, and Cambodia.

rics.how_to_use: Customs publishes detailed monthly bilateral and product-level import data. Major Chinese imports: integrated circuits, crude oil, iron ore, soybeans, copper, machinery. Track monthly YoY changes for cycle signal.

rics.meaning: Cumulative total import and export trade between China and India. Published by China Customs ~7-10th of the following month. Captures merchandise trade flows in both directions, reflecting India's role as a mid-tier trading partner for China.
rics.how_to_use: Track bilateral trade trajectory against geopolitical flashpoints (e.g., 2020 Galwan Valley standoff froze certain categories). India import surge in electronics/chemicals signals supply-chain shifts. Compare YoY to assess whether border tensions are spilling into trade flows.

rics.meaning: Cumulative bilateral import and export trade between China and Indonesia. Released by China Customs ~7-10th of each month. Indonesia is a key supplier of coal, nickel ore, and palm oil to China, making this series sensitive to commodity cycles.
rics.how_to_use: Decompose by commodity direction: Indonesia exports nickel ore and coal to China (electric-vehicle battery supply chain) and imports manufactured goods. Rising Indonesian nickel trade signals EV upstream investment. Watch for Indonesia's ore-export ban effects on refined nickel flows.

rics.meaning: Cumulative bilateral import and export trade between China and Malaysia. Published by China Customs ~7-10th of each month. Malaysia is a critical semiconductor packaging hub and LNG supplier; the series is closely tied to semiconductor supply-chain flows.
rics.how_to_use: Malaysia's role as a re-export conduit for semiconductors (especially post-2018 US tariffs) means spikes in Malaysia bilaterals can signal trade-flow rerouting. Monitor against chip import data; elevated Malaysia trade with compressed Korea/Taiwan flows is a diversion signal.

rics.meaning: Cumulative bilateral import and export trade between China and the Philippines. Released by China Customs ~7-10th of each month. Philippines supplies nickel ore and agricultural products to China; China exports electronics, machinery, and consumer goods.
rics.how_to_use: Nickel ore flows from the Philippines are critical for stainless steel and battery production. Track nickel ore volumes against LME nickel prices and Chinese NPI (nickel pig iron) output to assess substitution. South China Sea tensions can abruptly interrupt nickel shipments.

rics.meaning: Cumulative bilateral import and export trade between China and Russia. Published by China Customs ~7-10th of each month. Post-February 2022 this series surged dramatically as China absorbed discounted Russian oil, gas, coal, and agricultural products diverted from Western sanctions.
rics.how_to_use: The post-2022 surge is the dominant story: China-Russia trade roughly doubled by 2023. Decompose into energy (crude oil, LNG, coal) vs non-energy. Rising Russian bilaterals with stable or falling Western bilaterals signals structural re-orientation of China's energy sourcing. Monitor for secondary-sanctions risk caps.

rics.meaning: Cumulative bilateral import and export trade between China and Singapore. Released by China Customs ~7-10th of each month. Singapore serves as a regional financial and entrepot hub; bilateral trade reflects both genuine Singapore-origin goods and re-export of ASEAN commodities.
rics.how_to_use: Singapore is an entrepot: high bilateral trade can reflect routing of third-country goods. Use as a regional trade-flow gauge alongside Malaysia and Vietnam. Elevated Singapore bilaterals during US tariff periods may indicate re-routing. Track petrochemical and semiconductor flows.

rics.meaning: Cumulative bilateral import and export trade between China and Thailand. Published by China Customs ~7-10th of each month. Thailand exports natural rubber, fruits, and electronic components; China exports machinery and consumer goods. Thailand hosts significant Chinese EV manufacturing investment.
rics.how_to_use: Rising Thailand bilaterals in autos and EV components reflect China's push to use Thailand as a manufacturing and export base for Southeast Asia. Natural rubber imports from Thailand feed China's tire industry. Track alongside natural rubber import data (aCNCNDMLNM) for supply-chain coherence.

rics.meaning: Cumulative bilateral import and export trade between China and Vietnam. Released by China Customs ~7-10th of each month. Vietnam is China's largest ASEAN trading partner and a major recipient of Chinese FDI in electronics manufacturing; bilateral trade exceeded $170B/year by 2023.
rics.how_to_use: Vietnam has become a key assembly hub for Chinese electronics destined for the US and EU, creating a large intermediate-goods trade with China. Elevated Vietnam bilaterals while US China trade falls signals tariff-driven supply-chain rerouting. Critical for tracking semiconductor and electronics assembly flows.

rics.description: IMPORTS - SORGHUM, Current Prices, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly value of China's sorghum imports at current prices. Published by China Customs ~7-10th of each month. China is one of the world's largest sorghum importers, primarily sourcing from the US and Australia for use as animal feed and distilled spirits (baijiu) production.
rics.how_to_use: Pair with volume data (aCNIMSORGP) to isolate price vs volume effects. US sorghum imports collapsed during 2018-19 trade war, replaced by Australian supplies. Sorghum demand tracks hog-cycle restocking and baijiu production. Compare to corn imports (a feed substitute) to assess substitution dynamics.

rics.description: IMPORTS - SORGHUM, Volume, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly volume of China's sorghum imports. Published by China Customs ~7-10th of each month. Volume data isolates the quantity dimension of sorghum trade, separating physical demand from price effects. China imported roughly 8-10 million tonnes of sorghum annually at peak.
rics.how_to_use: Key metric for tracking animal feed demand cycles. When sorghum volume rises sharply alongside corn (aCNCNGWPJ), it signals broad feed restocking, often ahead of hog population rebuilding. Volume collapse during 2018-19 US tariff period is well-documented; track diversification to Australia/Argentina.

rics.meaning: Monthly value of China's imports of unwrought zinc and zinc alloys. Published by China Customs ~7-10th of each month. China is both a major zinc producer and consumer; import levels fluctuate based on domestic smelter output, galvanizing demand, and LME price arbitrage.
rics.how_to_use: Compare against domestic refined zinc output from NBS to assess the production-vs-import balance. Imports surge when LME zinc prices fall relative to domestic Shanghai Futures Exchange (SHFE) zinc, creating an import arbitrage window. Downstream galvanized steel demand (construction, auto) drives underlying zinc consumption.

rics.meaning: Monthly value of China's imports of zinc and related products, covering a broader range than unwrought zinc including zinc compounds, powders, and fabricated forms. Published by China Customs ~7-10th of each month. Reflects China's role as the dominant global zinc consumer (~50% of world demand).
rics.how_to_use: Use together with unwrought zinc data (aCNIMUWZAA) to capture total zinc trade exposure. Differentiate: unwrought zinc feeds smelting/refining while fabricated zinc compounds feed industrial chemicals and rubber vulcanization. Track against galvanized steel output as the primary downstream demand signal.

rics.meaning: Year-on-year percentage change in China's total merchandise imports. Published by China Customs ~7-10th of each month alongside the absolute import value. This is the headline growth-rate metric for China's import demand, widely cited in global macro commentary.
rics.how_to_use: THE summary import momentum indicator. A negative print signals domestic demand weakness (investment or consumption slowdown) or commodity price deflation. Context matters: 2023 saw sustained negative prints driven by commodity price falls, not demand collapse. Pair with PPI for price-vs-volume decomposition. Key for EM risk sentiment.

rics.meaning: Monthly value of China's imports of ABS (Acrylonitrile Butadiene Styrene) resin. Published by China Customs ~7-10th of each month. ABS resin is a key engineering plastic used in automotive interiors, consumer electronics casings, and household appliances.
rics.how_to_use: ABS imports track downstream auto and consumer electronics production cycles. Korea and Taiwan are the dominant suppliers; a surge in ABS imports signals accelerating auto/appliance output. Compare against domestic ABS production (NBS chemical output data) to assess import dependency. Petrochemical feedstock prices (butadiene, styrene) drive cost pass-through.

rics.meaning: Alternate monthly series for China's ABS resin import value. Published by China Customs ~7-10th of each month. This series may capture a slightly different commodity classification or time base versus aCNCNBKBMM; use both to cross-validate ABS trade flows.
rics.how_to_use: Cross-reference with aCNCNBKBMM to identify any classification or timing differences. In aggregate, ABS resin imports were ~1-2 million tonnes per year. Rising imports with flat domestic production signal demand outpacing local capacity; falling imports signal domestic substitution or demand softness.

rics.meaning: Monthly value of China's air conditioner imports. Published by China Customs ~7-10th of each month. Given China's massive domestic HVAC manufacturing capacity, air conditioner imports are relatively small and concentrated in high-end or specialized units from Japan and South Korea.
rics.how_to_use: China dominates global AC production; imports are niche (high-efficiency or specialized industrial units). Rising import value signals either premium-segment penetration or specific industrial cooling demand. Compare against NBS household appliance production indices for context on domestic capacity utilization.

rics.meaning: Alternate monthly series for China's air conditioner import value. Published by China Customs ~7-10th of each month. May reflect a different HS code sub-category or vintage vs aCNCNLLKAM (e.g., room vs central HVAC systems).
rics.how_to_use: Use alongside aCNCNLLKAM for a fuller picture of AC import flows. Central air/commercial HVAC imports from Japan (Daikin, Mitsubishi) command higher per-unit values. Track import volumes against domestic construction completion rates — commercial building completions drive commercial HVAC demand.

rics.meaning: Monthly value of China's imports of aircraft parts and components. Published by China Customs ~7-10th of each month. China is a growing aviation market with a large fleet of Airbus and Boeing aircraft; parts imports track MRO (maintenance, repair, overhaul) demand and new aircraft deliveries.
rics.how_to_use: Cross-reference with civil aviation fleet growth and MRO spend data. Rising aircraft parts imports signal healthy airline operations and capacity expansion. Geopolitical tensions (e.g., US export controls) can create supply disruptions; monitor for diversification toward Airbus parts over Boeing. Relevant for COMAC C919 ramp-up tracking.

rics.description: Import, alumina, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly value of China's alumina (aluminum oxide) imports. Published by China Customs ~7-10th of each month. Alumina is the intermediate product between bauxite and aluminum metal; China imports it from Australia, India, and Guinea to supplement domestic refining.
rics.how_to_use: Alumina imports track aluminum smelter utilization. When domestic bauxite and refinery capacity is tight, alumina imports rise. Australia is the primary supplier (~50% of imports). Pair with aluminum metal imports (aCNCNMYNQM) and SHFE aluminum prices to assess the full supply-chain picture.

rics.description: Import, alumina, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Alternate monthly value series for China's alumina imports. Published by China Customs ~7-10th of each month. Cross-reference with aCNCNPKDCM to validate alumina import flows; differences may reflect separate HS classifications or reporting lags.
rics.how_to_use: Use in conjunction with aCNCNPKDCM for a complete alumina import picture. Rising alumina import values, especially from Australia, reflect tightening bauxite refinery capacity in China. Track against NBS aluminum production data — alumina imports feed domestic smelters processing ~7 tonnes of alumina per 2 tonnes of aluminum metal.

rics.description: Import, alumina, Volume, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly volume of China's alumina imports. Published by China Customs ~7-10th of each month. Volume data separates physical alumina demand from price effects; critical for assessing smelter input procurement patterns and supply security.
rics.how_to_use: Volume surges signal aluminum smelter restart cycles; volume declines indicate smelter curtailments or domestic refinery capacity additions. China imported ~5-8 million tonnes of alumina annually. Pair with value data (aCNCNPKDCM) to compute implicit import price; compare to London alumina price indices.

rics.description: Import, aluminum, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly value of China's aluminum metal imports. Published by China Customs ~7-10th of each month. Despite being the world's largest aluminum producer (~60% of global output), China occasionally imports primary aluminum for arbitrage or specific alloy grades.
rics.how_to_use: Aluminum imports into China are unusual given its dominant production position; import volumes track LME-vs-SHFE price arbitrage windows. When SHFE aluminum trades at a premium to LME plus freight/duty, imports rise. Imports of high-purity or specific aerospace-grade alloys from Japan/Germany are more structural.

rics.description: Import, aluminum, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Alternate monthly value series for China's aluminum imports. Published by China Customs ~7-10th of each month. May capture a different classification category such as aluminum alloys, semi-fabricated products, or scrap aluminum versus primary metal.
rics.how_to_use: Differentiate from aCNCNMYNQM by product form: if this series tracks aluminum scrap or semi-fabricates, it maps to recycling and downstream processing capacity. Rising aluminum scrap imports reflect circular-economy policies (China's scrap import bans reshaped global flows post-2017).

rics.description: Import, aluminum, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Third monthly value series for China's aluminum imports. Published by China Customs ~7-10th of each month. Multiple series across aluminum categories reflect the breadth of HS codes covering primary aluminum, alloys, powder, and plates.
rics.how_to_use: Aggregate aCNCNMYNQM, aCNCNZWZFM, and this series for total aluminum import exposure. Compare aggregate import value to NBS aluminum production output (monthly ~3.4 million tonnes) — China's domestic supply is dominant, so import spikes are meaningful signals of localized shortage or arbitrage.

rics.description: Import, aluminum, Volume, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly volume of China's aluminum imports. Published by China Customs ~7-10th of each month. Volume data is essential for separating price-driven value changes from physical supply flows in the aluminum market.
rics.how_to_use: Monthly aluminum import volumes are typically small (tens of thousands of tonnes versus ~3.4M tonnes of monthly domestic production). Spikes in volume above normal ranges signal arbitrage windows or specific alloy-grade shortages. Pair with SHFE-LME price spread data for timing of import surges.

rics.description: Import, aluminum, Volume, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Alternate monthly volume series for China's aluminum imports. Published by China Customs ~7-10th of each month. May cover a sub-category of aluminum products; compare with aCNCNQYJJM to assess coverage differences.
rics.how_to_use: Use alongside aCNCNQYJJM for complete aluminum volume import tracking. Separate domestic production from import contributions to assess supply adequacy. Downstream aluminum demand — construction (profiles, sheets), automotive (die-castings), packaging (foil, can stock) — drives Chinese aluminum consumption of ~40M tonnes/year.

rics.meaning: Monthly value of China's anthracite (hard coal) imports. Published by China Customs ~7-10th of each month. Anthracite is the highest-carbon grade of coal; China imports it mainly from Russia, Vietnam, and North Korea for industrial applications including steel electrode production and heating.
rics.how_to_use: Anthracite imports track specialty industrial demand. Post-2022, Russian anthracite surged to compensate for disrupted North Korean and Western supply routes. Compare against thermal coal (aCNCNGWPJ) for the full coal import picture. SRB strategic coal stockpiling can distort short-term volumes.

rics.description: Import, antibiotic preparations, Current Prices, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly value of China's imports of antibiotic preparations (finished pharmaceutical dosage forms). Published by China Customs ~7-10th of each month. Despite being a global API manufacturer, China imports specialized patented antibiotic formulations from Europe and the US.
rics.how_to_use: Antibiotic preparation imports track demand for patented or novel formulations not yet produced domestically. Compare against API (active pharmaceutical ingredient) export volumes to assess China's position in the global pharmaceutical value chain. Rising imports may signal healthcare system quality upgrades.

rics.description: Import, antibiotic preparations, Volume, Imports & Exports, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: Monthly volume of China's antibiotic preparation imports. Published by China Customs ~7-10th of each month. Volume data allows price-per-unit computation and tracks physical import demand independent of pricing shifts.
rics.how_to_use: Combine with value data (aCNCNQHSOM) to compute implied unit value — rising unit value with stable volume signals premium product shift; volume surge with flat value signals generic formulation imports. Compare to China's rising domestic pharmaceutical consumption driven by aging population and NHC reimbursement list expansions.

rics.meaning: Monthly value of China's imports of bulk antibiotics excluding finished preparations (i.e., API or intermediate forms). Published by China Customs ~7-10th of each month. This is paradoxical given China's global dominance in antibiotic API production; imports likely reflect specific intermediates or advanced compounds.
rics.how_to_use: China is the world's largest antibiotic API exporter (penicillin, erythromycin, tetracycline). Bulk antibiotic imports are small and niche — track for specialized compound access or quality-grade imports from Europe. Pair with pharmaceutical product imports (aCNCNLZNEM) for total pharma import picture.

rics.subcategory: Bean Cake & Soybean Meal Imports — Series A
rics.meaning: Monthly value of China's imports of bean cake and soybean meal (the protein-rich residue from soybean crushing). Published by China Customs ~7-10th of each month. Soybean meal is the dominant protein supplement in Chinese livestock feed, consumed by hog, poultry, and aquaculture industries.
rics.how_to_use: This series tracks the processed protein trade, distinct from raw soybean imports. Rising soybean meal imports alongside falling raw soybean imports indicate domestic crushing capacity is insufficient to meet feed demand. Compare against hog inventory data and ASF (African Swine Fever) rebuilding cycles for demand context.

rics.subcategory: Bean Cake & Soybean Meal Imports — Series B
rics.meaning: Alternate monthly value series for China's bean cake and soybean meal imports. Published by China Customs ~7-10th of each month. Cross-reference with aCNCNMVIOM and aCNCNRQXSM to validate total soybean meal import volumes.
rics.how_to_use: Brazil and Argentina are the primary suppliers of soybean meal; US meal is less competitive due to shipping costs. Track trade-war substitution dynamics — during 2018-19 tariff periods, US soybean/meal imports plunged, replaced by Brazilian and Argentine supplies. Seasonal patterns driven by Southern Hemisphere harvest cycles (March-May).

rics.subcategory: Bean Cake & Soybean Meal Imports — Series C
rics.meaning: Third monthly series for China's bean cake and soybean meal import tracking. Published by China Customs ~7-10th of each month. Multiple series may reflect HS classification differences between soy protein concentrate, soybean meal, and other oilseed residues.
rics.how_to_use: Aggregate across aCNCNMVIOM, aCNCNZEFEM, and this series for comprehensive oilseed protein import tracking. China crushes ~90-100 million tonnes of soybeans domestically per year; residual meal imports fill the gap. High soybean meal imports relative to raw soybean imports signal domestic crushing capacity constraints.

rics.subcategory: Billet & Rough Forgings Imports — Series A
rics.meaning: Monthly value of China's imports of steel billets and rough forgings. Published by China Customs ~7-10th of each month.
